name: paywall-upgrade
annotation: HIFI-43 · /subscription, /upgrade, /locked/[pageKey] · dark shell w/ CIA purple glow

modules.build: rgba(10,10,15,.6) scrim overlay; drag handle centered y330 h4 w40 bg #FEFAF3 opacity 20%
.glass-frost sheet r28 top corners, full width; 4.5% fill, 8% border, 1px inner highlight
H2 24px 'unlock CIA's *upgrade*' centered Paper-100 #FEFAF3; Caption 12px 'You have reached the free tier limit' centered opacity 60%
GlassCard r20; PaywallLock blur(20px) on attempted feature; center lock icon 28px #FF5E00; Caption 12px 'Premium feature'
SolidCard #211008 r24; PricingMatrixRow headers Overline 11px 'free | plus | pro'; Plus column highlight 1px border #7F24FF; matrix rows 36px height
BtnPrimary full width 'Start 7-day free trial' #FF5E00 glow; Caption 12px '$20/mo. cancel anytime' centered; ChipProvenance 'via app store' label
Stacked column, centered: BtnGhost 'Compare all plans' then BtnGhost 'Maybe later'; both Paper-100 opacity 60%, equal visual weight (non-coercive exit)

trustControls: Source chips (ChipProvenance) on money/billing data include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete, per spec Consent and Safety
No false urgency: trial CTA 'Start 7-day free trial' pairs with visible terms '$20/mo. cancel anytime' — never hidden or fine-printed
Equal visual weight applied to both dismissal actions — 'Compare all plans' and 'Maybe later' — same centering/opacity, non-coercive exit
Price honest-null: 'Price unavailable' + HonestNullState 'we couldn't reach billing - try again later' replaces the price — never a fabricated number
Trial honest-null: CTA falls back to 'Upgrade to Plus' direct-purchase copy (never a false trial offer) when the API confirms trial ineligibility
notes: Entrance: sheet springs up 250ms, grid headers fade in; matrix cells settle and Plus column --glow-cia blooms once; prices count up from 0, CTA fades in last. Total ~2.5-2.8s, calm structural reveal.

Physical easing: sheet slides down proportional to drag velocity — fast flick dismisses, slow drag springs back. Purple matrix glow breathes on a 4s ease in/out cycle (CIA-active signal, not urgency).
Error (IAP failure): CTA reverts from spinner to standard BtnPrimary; red text 'Purchase failed - try again or contact support.' below.
Error (offline): cached matrix stays visible behind OfflineBanner 'Showing saved plans - reconnect to update prices.'; CTA disabled at 40% opacity.
Success: CTA fills BtnSuccess forest green (#34A853) with checkmark, holds 1.5s, sheet slides down and auto-dismisses. No confetti overlay.

Skeleton: grid geometry preserved; SkeletonState blocks on pricing tiles, ghost pills on matrix cells; delay >1.5s shows 'Loading your plans' (state-scoped italic on 'plans', distinct from the default composition's single italic word 'upgrade').

Comparison Matrix Features bullet in the source spec ends with no listed rows (spec truncated) — tier headers and the Plus-column CIA highlight are spec-true; individual feature-row copy is not fabricated.
PricingMatrixRow is a custom ListRow variant built for nested three-point (Free/Plus/Pro) alignment, promoted per the spec's own component rationale.
Accessibility (per spec): Paper-100 (#FEFAF3) on --surface-2 (#211008) = 15.8:1; Paper-50 (#FDFDFB) on --glow-cia purple = 6.2:1 — both AA+ pairs.

Corrections vs. draft: ghost-exit copy re-cased to the spec's exact quoted strings 'Compare all plans' / 'Maybe later' (draft had lowercased 'compare all plans' / 'maybe later'); added honest-null price/trial trust controls and OfflineBanner/error copy the draft omitted.
